reviews.title: I’ve tried them all!
reviews.text: I’ve tried every fasting app and always come back to this one. My favorite feature is the timer that also educational. It helps awareness of your internal process like when you are lowering your blood sugar, in the fat burning zone, the ketosis zone. It is extremely motivational! Another feature that is extremely beneficial is it reminds you to drink and log your water! I often get my hunger and thirst cues intertwined so it’s really trained me to hydrate when I used to binge. I also can’t live without the notification that helps you remember to start your fast! It has cut out my late night munchies and blood sugar roller coaster!

reviews.title: Fasting App
reviews.text: 18:6 intermittent fasting, where you fast for 18 hours and eat within a 6-hour window, is an effective approach to weight management and improving metabolic health. The fasting window encourages your body to burn fat for energy while enhancing cellular repair. Using an app to track your fasting schedule makes it easier to stick to your goals. It helps monitor eating windows, reminds you to hydrate, and records progress, providing motivation and accountability. The app also offers helpful insights, like tracking sleep patterns and physical activity, ensuring that fasting becomes part of a balanced, healthy lifestyle.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: I like this app and use it to fast with my friends. I think it has a lot of potential but the analytics are buggy to say the least. It’s always adding extra fasts, the hours on the graph are not accurate on the “all” tab, and the refresh rate for the app in general is so slow I have to hard close it and open it again for accuracy. For example if I opened my app at 4:45, and then open it again at 5:30 to start my fast, my app will start the fast at 4:45 because it still thinks it’s 4:45. Please do bug fixes and keep working on your app. It’s disheartening the last update was three months ago (as of writing this review).

reviews.text:
- all these apps add all this extra stuff like water tracking and whatever, idc
- I just want to:
-- get a reminder at a set time to fast
-- in that notification I can trigger an action to start my fast
-- get a notification when my fast is over 
-- in this 2nd notification I can trigger an action to end my fast
-- I don't want to ever have to open the app myself to use it 
-- I don't care to see my fasting history

reviews.title: Top free fasting app
reviews.text: I have tried quite a few of the “recommended” fasting apps only to delete them shortly after. This app allows you to do everything you need with a partner to motivate. You can add water, and time your fasts with ease. Easy to navigate the different types of fast and different levels of fasting, and it also adds in a lot of educational information. I would definitely recommend this app to beginners or even experts. You can even add your Apple health account to it and sync them together.

reviews.title: Love this APP
reviews.text: Since I started intermittent fasting I have tried so many different apps and none of them have compared to this one. I love having every thing in one place. Being able to log my water intake, my exercise, and keep track of my fasting in one place has been fantastic. I also love being able to add buddies and encourage each other through our fasting journey. It gives that extra motivation that I need. I also am thankful for how easy it is to use and enter in my information daily. I would recommend this app to anyone else who would love to try intermittent fasting, or even people who have been doing it for awhile and want an easier way to keep track!

It connects to apple and android watches, which is awesome. But it’s not ONLY for beginners, so don’t think that! It’s great for professionals too!  If you are on the ledge about it, JUST DO IT!
